title: Preview and export transitions with explicit fallbacks
description:
## Behavior
As an author, I can understand how a transition behaves on supported and unsupported graphics devices.

## Acceptance scenarios
Given the same fixture, when previewed and exported, then reference frames agree within documented tolerances. Given unavailable graphics features, a documented fallback or actionable error replaces silent corruption. Dispose textures and capture resources when compositions unload.

## Ownership
stdlib, toolchain, player

## Evidence
Link implementation, runnable fixtures, and verification results before closing. Keep product-boundary decisions in the parent initiative.

## Implementation handoff
Do not dispatch this broad story directly. Dispatch the bounded Terra packets under this milestone: videoml-0633d1, videoml-5491a0. Binding contracts/defaults and review gates are in initiative videoml-dbc2b1 D01–D15. Story closure requires all relevant packet evidence and primary review.
